# Charter — S00 usage inventory (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

## Mandate

Measure from durable and sampled evidence which fr, RM, Planka and n8n operations are actually used,
and publish one signed `parity/parity.yaml` that every slice consumes as `parity_ids`.

## Scope

Every fr served operation plus handlers absent from the served spec; all RM routes; all Planka openapi
paths; distinct `(package, resource, operation)` tuples in active n8n workflows; named flows; row counts
and Keycloak clients as evidence. Out: coding-*, artifacts, worker_management, inference-router,
licenses, billing_service; n8n flows as features; procedure_management's endpoints; UI screens;
performance; data migration.

## Expected outputs

`project-brief`, `evidence`.

## Closure outputs

`evidence` — the published inventory record: the 1,300-row `parity/parity.yaml` at its commit, its
sha256, the sample identifiers and the status split.

## Benefit

B1 (auditable decisions): the inventory is the evidence that the port drops zero-usage surface
instead of porting it.

## Tranche

0 (closed). This charter is recorded retrospectively; the work was delivered 2026-11-07/08 and is
verified from the repository, not re-run against sources that no longer exist.

## Acceptance

The feature list is signed and zero-usage features are dropped, not ported.

# Closure review — S00 usage inventory

## Outcome vs acceptance

The declared gate is "the feature list is signed; zero-usage features are dropped, not ported." The
inventory records 1,300 surfaces, 244 of them explicitly dropped and 543 unused; the port set is the
218 used plus the 295 rare. The gate is met on the record.

## Evidence

`parity/parity.yaml` (1,300 rows), `parity/evidence/` (preflight, samples, counts, match script), the
acceptance manifest, and the slice plan. The evidence classes are A 173, B 66, D 1,061.

## Open items

The samples are dated 2026-11-07/08 and the live sources have moved on; a re-measurement is not
recoverable from the estate and is not claimed.

## Decision

Close the project. The original closure row (2026-11-17) remains; this review supersedes it and is
dated 2026-11-21.

# Closure — S00 usage inventory (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

## Outcome

The inventory exists at `parity/parity.yaml`: 1,300 rows — 218 used, 295 rare, 543 unused, 244 dropped
— with class A/B/D evidence per row and the supporting samples under `parity/evidence/`. The gate's
"zero-usage features are dropped, not ported" holds: the 543 unused rows are not in the port set.

## Evidence

- `parity/parity.yaml` (1,300 rows) and `parity/evidence/` (samples, counts, the matching script)
- the acceptance manifest run at the branch SHA
- the original slice plan `docs/plans/slices/S00-usage-inventory.md`

## Decision

Close S00 as a reworked decision project. The old closure row remains; this record supersedes it. The
live sources that produced the samples (fr, RM, Planka, n8n) have moved on since 2026-11-08; the
inventory is the durable record and is not re-measured.

## Open items

A re-measurement is out of scope for the rework; it would be a new project.

# Project brief — S00 usage inventory (retrospective, 2026-11-26)

## Outcome

S00 produced one signed contract for what the rebuild owes: parity/parity.yaml holds 1,300 surfaces classified as 218 used, 295 rare, 543 unused and 244 dropped, sampled on 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-08. Every later slice consumes the ids from that list, and S14 gates on 100 % of used. Zero-usage surface is dropped rather than ported (D2/R5), so the rebuild starts from measured use rather than from the full surface of fr, RM, Planka and n8n.

## Boundary

Out of scope: coding-*, artifacts, worker_management, inference-router, licenses and billing_service (D12/D14); n8n flows as features, which S13 re-authors from the same evidence; procedure_management's 54 endpoints, carried as one SUMMARY line (D10); UI screens (S12); performance; and data migration (D7). The project must not fork a second inventory: parity.yaml is the only list, and a consuming slice may not restate or re-classify a surface of its own. A re-measurement is also out of scope, because the samples are dated and the live sources have moved on.

## Reuse sources

The measurement reuses existing sources rather than a new instrument: fr backend/src/capabilities/served-spec.lock.json at fr@4a579e91d355 for 785 served operations over 616 paths; RM src/routers at rm@191086942ce5 for 314 decorators; Planka docs/openapi.json at kanban@aafb771cea4c for 67 paths; n8n workflow_entity for the active operation tuples; the istio-proxy logs for the two Loki samples; execution_entity for the execution census; pg_stat_user_tables for the fr table counts; and the keycloak client table for the client evidence.
